title: [BUG]: OAuth callback "Fetch Tools" button broken due to CSP regression
summary:
### 🐞 Bug Summary
After completing OAuth authorization for MCP servers (Notion, ClickUp, Gamma, Granola), the "Fetch Tools from MCP Server" button on the OAuth success page fails silently. Browser console shows CSP violations and `ReferenceError: Can't find variable: fetchTools`.
